title: Mixed monorepo with .vue, category/scope selection, interrupt, next-day resume
steps: Ensure scan-extensions include .vue (or equivalent fixture source).
Run lodestar-audit with a category subset and changed-since or package scope.
Interrupt mid-discover or mid-plan; stop the session.
Resume on a later calendar day from findings.md / checkpoints.
Record usage.resume success|failed and artifact bytes.
